definitions.price_basis: adjusted daily OHLC; raw close times volume for turnover
definitions.candle_colour: raw close versus raw open; equal values remain doji
definitions.pivot: strict 2 left / 2 right; known at confirmation close; usable next market session
definitions.structural_break: close crosses latest unconsumed confirmed level; direction from prior break; initial is not BOS/CHoCH
definitions.ambiguity: daily high above prior swing high and daily low below prior swing low: skip structural signals and reset direction
definitions.common: 60 consecutive valid eligible positive-volume sessions; current 20-session mean raw close times volume >= NTD 50 million
definitions.fvg: low[T] > high[T-2]; middle close > high[T-2], middle and T red; gap >= 0.1 * prior simple ATR14; T close > MA60
definitions.retest: sessions 1..10 after formation; overlap zone, red close above upper edge, common eligibility; invalidate close below lower edge first
definitions.orderblock: bull close-break: last black candle within previous 10 consecutive sessions, full low-high range; same retest rule
definitions.sweep: low below unconsumed confirmed swing low, red close above it; once per swing low
definitions.breakout20: red close above previous 20 highs and volume >= 1.5 prior 20-session average; previous known condition false
definitions.missing: invalid, ineligible, nonfinite or nontrading session resets pivots and direction; active zones become data_missing
definitions.expiry: retest allowed on session 10; otherwise expire at that session close; sample-end zones stay pending
definitions.cohort: all qualifying FVG and orderblock formations retained, even if no later retest; same-day entry duplicates merged without deleting cohorts
definitions.variants: fixed research assumptions, not canonical or exhaustive SMC; no intraday path or institutional ownership inferred
definitions.signal_timing: T close confirmed, entry no earlier than T+1; no outcome or future row used

source_limitations: close-official filename retained for compatibility; post2026-09-09 values are FinMind bridged, not official-source adjusted
both post-anchor adjusted matrices use same provider and are not an independent two-source verification

signals at latest close have entry_date null pending next session; no future price inferred

Current master market matches are provisional, not daily official identity or suspension certification
